theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_covering_majorant
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (E : Set X) (f : X → Rn m) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 < k → Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal (m + k) E < ⊤ → LipschitzOnWith K f E → ∃ G : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable G ∧ (∀ y, Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal k (E ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ G y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, G y ∂volume ≤ Chapter01.realUnitBallVolume (m : ℝ) * Chapter01.realUnitBallVolume k / Chapter01.realUnitBallVolume (m + k) * (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal (m + k) E
